issues_detected.recommendation: Add is_deidentified with the method and identifiers removed from phenotype and metadata files.
issues_detected.description: human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects is true and demographic/clinical questionnaire data are released, but is_deidentified is absent; no deidentification method or removed identifiers are documented for the phenotype files.

issues_detected.recommendation: State applicable regulatory frameworks and confidentiality level; put the DACO address in data_governance.committee_contact.
issues_detected.description: No regulatory compliance statement or confidentiality classification (regulatory_restrictions absent; data_governance.committee_contact absent although a DACO address appears in prose).

issues_detected.recommendation: Record typed relationships to the adult dataset and Synapse raw-audio cohort when sources support them.
issues_detected.description: No parent_datasets or related_datasets; the adult Bridge2AI-Voice dataset and the Synapse raw-audio cohort are not linked as typed relationships (the record explains its decision in source_caveats).

issues_detected.recommendation: State format/standard conformance, link papers or protocols, and say whether imputation was used.
issues_detected.description: No conforms_to/conforms_to_schema for the released data, no imputation statement, and external resources limited to the project homepage.

issues_detected.recommendation: Summarize DUA-prohibited uses and specific research or ML tasks.
issues_detected.description: No prohibited or discouraged uses and no tasks; intended uses are three generic one-line statements.

issues_detected.recommendation: Describe phenotype variables, set is_tabular, and name represented conditions.
issues_detected.description: Variable metadata covers only four key columns; no is_tabular flag or subset/split flags; conditions or diagnoses represented among patients are never named.

issues_detected.recommendation: Add an updates block with maintenance plan or expected frequency.
issues_detected.description: No update schedule or maintenance plan (updates absent).

issues_detected.recommendation: Document limitations, categorized biases and social impacts.
issues_detected.description: known_limitations, known_biases and future_use_impacts absent despite evident single-site, English-proficiency and mixed-microphone constraints.
version_access.latest_version_doi (doi:10.13026/mf9s-5r03) differs from the record DOI (10.13026/h995-bt35) without explanation; plausibly PhysioNet's all-versions DOI.

issues_detected.recommendation: Keep attribution; prefer pediatric-specific sources where available.
issues_detected.description: Re-identification risk, compensation, withdrawal and some assent/consent statements come from the umbrella multi-site acquisition protocol rather than the pediatric release; the record attributes them explicitly.

issues_detected.recommendation: No change needed beyond confirming the award number with the funder.
issues_detected.description: Award 3OT2OD032720-01S1 (PhysioNet) vs 3OT2OD032720-01S3 (RePORTER page) discrepancy is flagged transparently in funders source_caveats; the recorded number follows NIH format.

issues_detected.recommendation: Add format/media_type for Parquet resources and state encoding.
issues_detected.description: Parquet resources lack structured format/media_type fields and no character encoding is stated; distribution_formats and download_url absent.

semantic_insights: Release-scoped record: it explicitly separates pediatric v1.1.0 facts from adult-dataset and umbrella-protocol documentation and attributes protocol-derived statements.
Strong technical transparency: feature-level STFT/Mel/MFCC parameters, b2aiprep 3.0.0 and openSMILE/Praat/parselmouth/torchaudio named as producers of released files.
Main gaps are Responsible-AI slots (limitations, biases, social impact), deidentification method, conformance standards and typed dataset relationships.
